name: Mustang Custom Woodworking
old_description: If you don't see something that you are looking for I am happy to work with you on a custom design.
about:
Mustang Custom Woodworking operates out of Vancouver, Washington. The business was founded by Matt Thompson, who has always loved woodworking and turned his passion into a custom woodworking shop. Thompson describes his work as mixing his creative side with his mechanical nature to build one-of-a-kind pieces, a pursuit he finds rewarding because it meets specific client needs.

The shop specializes in custom woodworking, producing cabinetry, furniture, and dog kennels tailored to client specifications. Each piece is built to order, with Thompson handling design and fabrication from initial concept to final delivery.

Clients include homeowners seeking custom cabinetry and furniture, as well as those needing specialized items such as custom dog kennels. The business works directly with individuals to translate their ideas into finished wood products, offering design collaboration for any project not shown in the portfolio.

Thompson emphasizes the satisfaction of creating original pieces tailored to each client, striving for perfection and prioritizing the customer's best interest. He notes that the uniqueness of the work sets it apart from mass-produced alternatives, a point highlighted in a local newspaper feature where he described the joy of seeing a client's reaction to a finished piece.
